output.title: Show HN: Self-hostable no-code internal tools on top of your Postgres — schema in, working admin panel out
output.body:
I built StackBuilt, a self-hostable no-code tool that connects to your Postgres database, reads the schema, and instantly scaffolds CRUD interfaces, dashboards, and approval flows. It runs with a single Docker command, so production data never leaves your network.

The UI generates in under 60 seconds — shown unedited in the demo video. We include role-based access control in the free self-hosted tier, and only charge per builder; viewers are always free.

It's currently in beta, with a 200-person logistics company running it in production. Built with Go, React, and Docker, it's designed for engineers tired of rebuilding admin panels or justifying Retool's per-user cost.

Would love feedback on the scaffolding accuracy and edge cases in complex schemas.
